description: The VERSION structure in NTLMSSP NEGOTIATE, CHALLENGE and AUTHENTICATE messages (MS-NLMP 2.2.2.10): product major version, minor version and build. It appears in SMB2/3, HTTP Negotiate/NTLM, LDAP, RPC and more. Match the version of the host that sent the message. Ranges are inclusive and signatures are tried in order, first match wins.

signatures.label: unix-like
signatures.notes: Windows always fills in a build. Samba and other non-Windows NTLM code often send build 0 with a made-up major and minor.

signatures.label: windows-nt10
signatures.notes: Build 14393 is both Windows 10 1607 and Server 2016.

signatures.label: windows-nt10
signatures.notes: Build 17763 is both Windows 10 1809 and Server 2019.

signatures.label: windows-nt10
signatures.notes: Build 26100 is both Windows 11 24H2 and Server 2025.

signatures.label: windows-11
signatures.notes: Windows 11 21H2 (22000) through 23H2 (22631); 26100 is caught by ntlm-24h2 above.

signatures.label: windows-11
signatures.notes: Windows 11 25H2 and later client builds. Re-check when a new Server release ships.

signatures.label: windows-nt10
signatures.notes: Any other 10.0 build, including Insider builds and future releases.
